[package]
name = "campus-cli"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1.0.203", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.117"
clap = { version = "4.5.4", features = ["derive"], optional = true }

[dev-dependencies]
assert_cmd = "2.0.14"

[features]
default = []
cli = ["dep:clap"]

# Verify with: cargo test --all-features
